patterns.note: A full-bleed hero section features a dark overlay on a dynamic background, ensuring high contrast for prominent white text and a call-to-action.
Content sections alternate between dark backgrounds with light text and light backgrounds with dark text, creating clear visual separation and guiding the user's eye.
Prominent, large sans-serif headings are paired with smaller, highly legible body text, often with uppercase labels for emphasis in navigation and section titles.

A high-contrast palette of black, white, and various shades of gray is consistently accented by a vibrant teal/blue for interactive elements and key information, with an additional orange in a gradient.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to site sections.
Feature lists and process steps are presented in a grid of distinct cards or numbered items, each with a clear heading and concise description, maintaining visual consistency.

technique_notes: A full-width hero section uses a dark, semi-transparent overlay on a dynamic background (likely video or animation) to ensure optimal readability for white text and a primary call-to-action button.
Content sections are structured with generous vertical padding, alternating background colors (dark and light) to visually segment information and create a clear flow down the page.

A consistent typographic hierarchy is established using a large, bold sans-serif for headings, a lighter weight sans-serif for body text, and uppercase styling for labels and navigation items to convey a modern, authoritative feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, highly legible body text and uppercase navigation elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, cards, and input fields, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with airy padding in hero and full-width content sections, transitioning to a denser grid for feature cards and process steps.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated, high-tech aesthetic achieved through a dominant dark mode, a precise typographic hierarchy, and a vibrant teal accent. The integration of dynamic backgrounds and a clean, structured layout elevates it beyond a generic template, conveying authority and innovation in the medical technology space.
